messages.author: 8bf0927cf6c5a784
messages.subject: extracting per-sample methylation
parts:
I would like to have a table of differential methylation stats as well methylation ratios for each sample so I can see how variable the samples are.

For stats, it's easy to convert methylDiff object to a standard GRanges object.

For ratios, the united methylBase object has all the required info, but the column names are sample IDs (not sample names) and methylation ratios need to be calculated. There is also the percMethylation() function, which produces a matrix of ratios with column names as sample names, which is just want I want, but that matrix cannot be easily be converted to GRanges to merge with stats.

Did I miss some function that can combine these two table types? Is there a recommended way to do this?

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] extracting per-sample methylation
parts:
If you want to combine everything in a GRanges object you can convert the methylDiff to GRanges, and use GenomicRanges::mcols() to add extra columns from percMethylation() output. The order of rows between methylBase and methylDiff should be the same so you can use cbind() on metadata columns of GRanges object.

Best,
Altuna
